pairs.l: 1 — had a shop that was rather expensive?
2 — had very little on sale in their store?
3 — appeared different from how they really were?
7 — had a reputation for cheating customers?
8 — did not fit into the community?
10 — had a shop that appeared well organised?

r1.exp: 1=F (Frank: 'not a place for BARGAINS'). 2=E (Eve: 'the shelves always seemed to be BARE'). 3=D (Don: 'seemed a model citizen... prosecution for selling tobacco to minors came as SOMETHING OF A SURPRISE'). 4=E (Eve: 'keen to GOSSIP with the odd person that came in'). 5=A (Alice: 'owner had come FROM ABROAD'). 6=C (Cathy: 'only let us in FOUR AT A TIME' — paranoid about stealing). 7=B (Ben: 'said to OVERCHARGE people by giving wrong change'). 8=F (Frank: 'found it very difficult to be ACCEPTED BY THE LOCALS'). 9=D (Don: 'worked until MIDNIGHT'). 10=B (Ben: shop looked empty but 'everything had its PLACE'). 11=C (Cathy: 'rapidly FAILING EYESIGHT'). 12=B (Ben: Mrs Smith 'even known to EXTEND CREDIT').

r13.exp: 'Our PRIMARY MOTIVATION was to provide a SECURE ENVIRONMENT for the four of us' = htio je obitelji osigurati sigurno okružje = C.

r14.exp: 'Quite a way from the MAINLAND, which can be an INCONVENIENCE' = izoliranost mjesta = C.

r15.exp: 'A massive all-round adjustment is required and it DOES NOT OCCUR OVERNIGHT' = treba vremena za prilagodbu = B.

r16.exp: 'It's the SHORT DAYS that take the MOST GETTING USED TO' = nedostatak dnevnog svjetla = B.

r17.exp: 'I feel a certain sense of PRIDE at having successfully made the transition' = zadovoljan, ponosan = A.

r18.exp: 'It all boils down to THE KIND OF PERSON YOU ARE' = nije dobro rješenje za svakoga = D.

r19.exp: 'To do it full time is quite strenuous. (19)____. We do up to an hour and a half per set.' → H: YOU SEE, YOU HAVE TO BE IN CONTROL OF EVERY MUSCLE IN YOUR BODY.

r20.exp: 'Not blessed with a heart rate of 24bpm. (20)____. Ed can remain so still you'd swear he was made of stone.' → C: NOR DO I HAVE THE ABILITY TO GO FOR HALF AN HOUR WITHOUT BLINKING.

r21.exp: 'Not just about standing still. (21)____. If you do something SPECTACULAR, it amazes people.' → F: IT'S MORE ABOUT WHAT YOU DO WHEN YOU MOVE.

r22.exp: 'All five pitches will be occupied. (22)____. Saw BLOOD in the middle — someone was hospitalised.' → D: IT'S NOT UNKNOWN FOR PERFORMERS TO CLAIM THE BEST ONES AS EARLY AS 3AM, WHICH OCCASIONALLY LEADS TO VIOLENCE.

r23.exp: 'One person thinks I actually AM a statue. (23)____. I even start thinking perhaps I should MOVE so they realise it's a performance.' → G: ANOTHER CALLS ME 'IT' AND DISCUSSES ME AS IF I CAN'T HEAR.

r24.exp: 'I concentrate on keeping still. (24)____. How RUDE, I think – until I realise it's Ed.' → B: THAT IS, UNTIL A GUY STARTS TALKING TO ME.

r25.exp: 'Coincide WITH existing festivals' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: coincide with = poklapati se s.

r26.exp: 'Some are SO curious THAT they date back to ancient times' — korelativna konstrukcija: so + adjective + that.

r27.exp: 'Christmas tree-dressing HAS BEEN found' — present perfect passive za nešto pronađeno (relevantno za sadašnjost).

r28.exp: 'Chariot DRAWN by an eight-legged horse' — particip prošli (past participle) u pasivnoj konstrukciji.

r29.exp: 'Father Christmas SHOULD, more properly, be Mother Christmas' — 'should' za ispravnost/prikladnost (trebalo bi biti).

r30.exp: 'Handed OUT presents' — frazalni glagol: hand out = dijeliti, podjeljivati.

r31.exp: 'Santa's reindeer have an even stranger ORIGIN' — 'origin' = podrijetlo (odakle dolaze). Heredity/inheritance = nasljeđivanje; descent = silazak/porijeklo.

r32.exp: 'Sacred plants for MOST Indo-European cultures' — 'most' bez 'the' = mnoge, većina (bez specifičnog referenta).

r33.exp: 'Some modifications HAVE been made' — present perfect passive: have + been + past participle.

r34.exp: 'A way FOR blind people to read and write' — prijedlog 'for' uvodi korisnika/primatelja.

r35.exp: 'Give AWAY their positions' — frazalni glagol: give away = odati, otkriti (tajnu/položaj).

r36.exp: 'It HAD been created by Charles Barbier' — past perfect passive (radnja dovršena prije opisanog prošlog trenutka).

r37.exp: 'Consisted OF groups of raised dots' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: consist of = sastojati se od.

r38.exp: 'His own simplified system, WHICH we know today as Braille' — relativna zamjenica 'which' za nerestiktivnu relativnu rečenicu.

r39.exp: 'Reduced the number of dots BY half' — prijedlog 'by' za mjeru promjene (za polovinu).

r40.exp: 'Not widely accepted in his OWN time' — 'own' za naglašavanje (za njegova vlastita vremena).
